content_html:
There seem to be 2 main advantages for AI use (for me rn): knowing what you want and judgement. They are kind of related, but while the first one is about human leverage against other humans, the second comes from advantage against AI and all humans.
When thinking about it, what the ultimate usage and state of AI would be, I remembered of the Hayek paper "The Use of Knowldege in Society". Specifically, the point about specific knowledge. There are things, that by nature, are knowledge specific and cannot be aggregated to make decisions. Thinking in this context, my parallel was that in the end, humans are going to have different inputs because they have different lives. Better life. Better AI usage
